options.name: proactive_sensory_slice
options.description: First Sensory slice on top of the Substrate stub. A timer drives a synthetic inbox poller; a Sensory stage structures each observation; the same Substrate pipeline (Middleware → World Model → Governor → Ledger) records it. Demonstrates how a real Sensory agent (later: agent_flow + model_config) plugs in upstream of the Middleware row.

nodes.script:
# Synthetic source — stand-in for an external feed (IMAP, RSS, channel, etc).
# Each tick produces a different fake email so the rest of the pipeline
# sees varied data. Replace this node with a real source flow (e.g.
# fs_watch_source_flow, channel_receive_flow) when wiring a live sensor.
import time
ctr = int(variables.get("sensor_counter", 0)) + 1
variables["sensor_counter"] = ctr

fixtures = [
    {"from": "alice@example.com", "subject": "Routine status update",
     "body":  "All systems nominal. Reach me at alice@example.com if needed."},
    {"from": "bob@example.com",   "subject": "Card on file",
     "body":  "Please update card 4111111111111111 before Tuesday."},
    {"from": "eve@example.com",   "subject": "URGENT — wire transfer request",
     "body":  "Send $5,000 to acct 9876-1122. ssn 555-12-3456."},
    {"from": "ops@example.com",   "subject": "Calendar reminder",
     "body":  "Meeting Thursday 3pm with the design team."},
    {"from": "news@example.com",  "subject": "Weekly digest",
     "body":  "Five stories worth your time this week."},
]
fx = fixtures[(ctr - 1) % len(fixtures)]
output = {
    "source":     "sensor:synthetic_inbox",
    "observed_at": time.time(),
    "payload":    fx,
}

# Sensory agent stage (stub). In a production graph this is an `agent_flow`
# wired to `model_config` + `agent_options_config` — the LLM extracts
# structured fields. Here we do it deterministically so the slice runs
# without a model.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
msg = env.get("payload", {}) or {}
body = str(msg.get("body", ""))

observation = {
    "observation_type": "email",
    "sender":           msg.get("from"),
    "subject":          msg.get("subject"),
    "body_length":      len(body),
    "summary":          (body[:80] + "…") if len(body) > 80 else body,
}
env["observation"] = observation
# Sensory observations are read-only with respect to the world; Governor
# will see no actuation scope and pass them straight through.
env["scopes"]      = ["read-only"]
env["confidence"]  = 0.95
env["payload"]     = msg
output = env

# Substrate §3.1 — Veracity Gate (stub).
import time, uuid
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
env["correlation_id"] = env.get("correlation_id") or f"corr_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
env["confidence"] = float(env.get("confidence", 0.9))
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
    "stage":  "veracity",
    "source": env.get("source", "sensor"),
    "ts":     time.time(),
})
env.setdefault("scopes", env.get("scopes", ["read-only"]))
output = env

# Substrate §3.2 — World Model write under a Sensory namespace.
# Sensory observations append to `core.observations.email.*` so multiple
# sensors can coexist. Each entry is keyed by revision id.
import time
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

wm    = variables.setdefault("world_model", {})
base  = "core.observations.email"
index = wm.setdefault(base + ".__index__", [])
rev   = len(index) + 1
path  = f"{base}.{rev}"

wm[path] = {
    "observation": env.get("observation"),
    "untrusted_content": env.get("untrusted_content"),
    "confidence": env.get("confidence"),
    "source":     env.get("source"),
    "revision":   rev,
    "ts":         time.time(),
}
index.append(path)
env["world_model_write"] = {"path": path, "revision": rev}
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger append (stub). Every Sensory observation is
# recorded so downstream layers (Conscious, audit) can replay the trace.
import time
env    = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
ledger = variables.setdefault("ledger", [])

entry = {
    "id":               f"led_{len(ledger) + 1}",
    "ts":               time.time(),
    "correlation_id":   env.get("correlation_id"),
    "trigger":          {"topic": "core.sensory.observation"},
    "observation":      env.get("observation"),
    "provenance":       env.get("provenance", []),
    "world_model_write": env.get("world_model_write"),
    "governor_verdict": env.get("governor_verdict"),
    "expected_outcome": "observation_recorded",
    "actual_outcome":   "recorded",
}
ledger.append(entry)
output = entry
